about: Third Kingdoms (1 Kings) tells about wise King Solomon, God's temple, and the brave prophet Elijah.

pages.title: Solomon Asks for Wisdom
pages.scene: Young King Solomon praying at night
pages.text: God told young King Solomon, "Ask for anything." Solomon did not ask for money or a long life. He said, "Please make me wise so I can lead your people well." God was pleased. He made Solomon very wise and gave him riches too.
pages.lesson: Ask God to make you wise.

pages.title: The Beautiful Temple
pages.scene: Solomon praying in front of the new temple
pages.text: Solomon built a beautiful temple for God in Jerusalem. It had gold walls and carved angels. When it was finished, God's glory filled the temple like a bright cloud. Solomon prayed, and all the people praised God.
pages.lesson: God loves to be with His people.

pages.title: Elijah and the Ravens
pages.scene: Ravens bringing bread to Elijah by a stream
pages.text: There was no rain for a long time. God told Elijah to hide by a little stream. Every morning and evening, ravens brought him bread and meat! Later a poor widow shared her last bread with Elijah, and God never let her flour run out.
pages.lesson: God takes care of us in surprising ways.

pages.title: Fire from Heaven
pages.scene: Fire falling on Elijah's altar on the mountain
pages.text: Many people prayed to a fake god named Baal. Elijah said, "Let's see who is the real God!" Baal's prophets shouted all day, but nothing happened. Elijah prayed once, and fire came down from heaven! The people cried, "The Lord is God!"
pages.lesson: There is only one true God.

pages.title: A Gentle Whisper
pages.scene: Elijah at the cave door hearing a gentle whisper
pages.text: Elijah was tired and scared, so he ran away. God gave him food and rest. Then God came close. There was a strong wind, an earthquake and a fire. But God was not in them. Then came a gentle whisper. It was God, telling Elijah, "You are not alone."
pages.lesson: God cares for you when you're tired and scared.
